verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
You clothe Yourself in light
A garment like the sun
Arrayed in holiness
The everlasting one

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
All other gods can’t see
They have ears but cannot hear
But You have made all things
You alone are to be feared

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
So we draw near in holy fear
O Lord, we sing as we gaze upon You

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
You shine brighter than the sun
In the heavens or on the earth
There is no, not one like You, Lord

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Holy Father
Holy Son
Holy Spirit
